verdict.rationale: Async job callbacks are a fair question for a transcription API, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents synchronous file transcription ('upload the audio and receive a final transcript'), streaming, and local CLI/Python use. Nothing in the pack shows registrable webhooks or callbacks that fire when a job completes or fails.

support.subject: As a developer, a webhook or callback fires when a job completes or fails, so nothing in my system has to poll
